## 📝 What This System Creates

Every opera includes:

| Asset Type | What You Get | Example |
|------------|--------------|---------|
| **📄 Libretto** | Complete opera with professional formatting | `hartford_ascending_complete_libretto.md` |
| **🖼️ Images** | AI-generated illustration for each scene | 5-8 high-res PNG files |
| **🎙️ Audio** | Dramatic narration of stage directions | MP3 files (~2-4 MB each) |
| **📰 Critique** | Scholarly AI-generated review | `opera_critique.md` |
| **📦 Organization** | All assets in structured directory | Ready for presentation |

## 🚀 Three Ways to Explore

### 1️⃣ **Browse Existing Operas** (No setup required)

```bash
cd showcase/hartford_ascending_an_opera_of_love_and_ruins/

# Read the complete libretto
cat hartford_ascending_complete_libretto.md

# View the critique
cat hartford_ascending_critique.md

# See all the assets
ls -lh
```

**Available operas:**
- `hartford_ascending_an_opera_of_love_and_ruins/` - 8 scenes, complete with music
- `iron_aria_the_lost_city_of_hartford/` - 6 scenes with illustrations
- `vines_of_hartford_arias_of_steel/` - Full narration suite + NotebookLM package

### 2️⃣ **Generate Your Own Opera** (Requires API keys)

```bash
# 1. Set up your API keys
export OPENAI_API_KEY=your_key
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your_key
export GOOGLE_API_KEY=your_key

# 2. Build the project
./gradlew build

# 3. Generate! (takes ~8-10 minutes for 5 scenes)
./gradlew run
```

**What happens:**
- GPT-5.2 and Claude Opus 4.5 write scenes alternately
- Gemini generates illustrations for each scene
- ElevenLabs creates dramatic narration (if configured)
- System saves everything to `production_runs/` directory

### 3️⃣ **Read the Documentation**

| Document | What It Covers |
|----------|----------------|
| **`OPERA_PREVIEW.md`** | Complete system overview with features |
| **`SHOWCASE_SUMMARY.md`** | Detailed asset inventory and examples |
| **`README.md`** | Full technical documentation |
| **`CLAUDE.md`** | Development context and architecture |

## 💡 Key Features At A Glance

### 🤖 Multi-Model AI Collaboration
- **GPT-5.2** (OpenAI) + **Claude Opus 4.5** (Anthropic) write scenes alternately
- **Gemini Nano Banana** (Google) creates illustrations
- **Gemini 3 Pro** (Google) generates critiques
- **ElevenLabs** synthesizes dramatic narration

### ✨ Automatic Professional Formatting
```markdown
**SANDRA** (soprano):
> What verdant wall impedes my quest,<br>
> Each fragrant root, each echoing cry?<br>
> Oh, Hartford, cradle of dreams long lost,<br>
> Still you elude me: but I will not rest!
```
*Beautiful stanza formatting applied automatically - no manual work needed*

### 🎯 Complete Production Pipeline
1. **Text Generation** - AI models create narrative (~30 sec/scene)
2. **Automatic Formatting** - Professional opera layout applied
3. **Voice Narration** - Stage directions become audio (~10 sec/scene)
4. **Image Generation** - Scene illustrations created (~60 sec/scene)
5. **Critical Review** - AI critic analyzes the work (~20 sec)

### 🎵 External Integrations
- **Suno AI** - Generate actual opera music from libretti
- **NotebookLM** - Create AI podcasts discussing the work
- **JLayer** - Built-in audio playback for demonstrations

---

## 📊 By The Numbers

### Code Base
- **~2,400 lines** of Java code
- **19 source files** in main package
- **Java 21** with modern features (virtual threads, records, pattern matching)

### Generated Content
- **3 complete operas** in showcase directory
- **15+ scenes** with illustrations
- **20+ audio files** with narration and music
- **~100+ MB** of multimedia assets

### Performance
- **8-10 minutes** to generate a complete 5-scene opera
- **2 concurrent** image requests (rate-limited, configurable)
- **Professional quality** output ready for use

## 🌟 What Makes This Special

### 1. **True AI Collaboration**
Not just one AI - multiple models with different strengths working together:
- GPT-5.2 brings lyrical, evocative writing
- Claude Opus 4.5 adds precise, dramatic flair
- Gemini provides visual and critical perspectives

### 2. **Production-Ready Output**
Everything generated is immediately usable:
- Libretti formatted for reading or performance
- High-resolution images suitable for presentations
- Professional audio narration for showcases
- Scholarly critiques for program notes

### 3. **Modern Architecture**
Built with cutting-edge technology:
- Java 21 virtual threads for efficient concurrency
- LangChain4j for AI model orchestration
- Google GenAI SDK for image generation
- HttpClient for API integrations

### 4. **Extensible Design**
Easy to add new capabilities:
- Additional AI models
- New output formats
- More voice types
- Extended audio features

## 📖 Example: Hartford Ascending

**Premise:** Post-apocalyptic Connecticut where jungle has reclaimed civilization

**Characters:**
- Sandra (soprano) - Explorer seeking lost Hartford
- Lucian (tenor) - Jungle poet, falls in love with Sandra
- Maximilian (baritone) - Government agent trying to stop them
- Aria-7 Robot (bass) - Singing robot that performs Verdi in 3 languages

## 🚦 Quick Start Commands

```bash
# Browse existing operas
cd showcase/
ls -la

# Read a complete libretto
cat hartford_ascending_an_opera_of_love_and_ruins/hartford_ascending_complete_libretto.md

# Generate a new opera (requires API keys)
./gradlew run

# Generate with custom parameters
java -cp build/classes/java/main com.kousenit.IntegratedOperaGenerator "My Opera" 6

# Run tests
./gradlew test --tests AudioDemoTest          # Audio generation
./gradlew test --tests OperaCriticTest        # Critique generation
./gradlew test --tests ContinueHartfordOperaTest  # Opera continuation
```
